about.title: A Different Rhythm of Living
about.text1: In the hills of Verduno, within the vineyards of Monvigliero, Scarpa Villas offers a rare way to experience Barolo.
about.text2: Inspired by the philosophy of Scarpa, it goes beyond a place to stay – it is shaped by wine, time, and the land itself.
about.text3: Here, days unfold slowly, between the silence of the vines, the warmth of the sun, and the rituals of Piedmontese life.

experience.paragraph1: Scarpa Villas were created as a natural extension of the Scarpa winery — a place where the philosophy of wine can be lived, not only tasted.
experience.paragraph2: Founded in 1900, Scarpa has always believed that great wine is shaped by time, patience, and a deep connection to the land.
experience.paragraph3: The villas bring guests closer to that philosophy through the vineyards of Monvigliero, the culture of Barolo, and experiences rooted in the traditions of Piedmont.

discover.title: Discover The Langhe
discover.text1: Just minutes from the vineyards of Monvigliero, the Langhe unfolds through historic villages, panoramic viewpoints, and some of Italy’s most celebrated gastronomic destinations.
discover.text2: Each place offers a different way to experience the region — from wine and truffles to landscapes and centuries — old towns.

overview.title: Tettineive is the most spacious of the Scarpa Villas — designed for families, gatherings, and time spent together without losing a sense of privacy.
overview.description: Five bedrooms, generous living areas, and a large private garden create a setting where each moment unfolds naturally, between shared experiences and quiet personal time.

features.intro: At Tettineive, space becomes part of the experience.
features.paragraph1: Mornings begin in the quiet of the garden, with light stretching across the hills. Afternoons unfold slowly — between conversation, rest, and time outdoors.
features.paragraph2: In the evening, the villa gathers everyone together again — around the table, in the open air, or simply watching the landscape change with the light.

bottom.title: Outside, a large private garden opens towards the vineyards, offering space to relax, gather, or simply take in the landscape.
bottom.description:
Whether for breakfast in the morning light
or a quiet moment at sunset, the outdoors becomes an essential part of the stay.

overview.title: La Bogliona is the most intimate of the Scarpa Villas — a space designed for couples and small groups who value privacy, warmth, and a slower rhythm of living.
overview.description: With its direct view of the infinity pool and the surrounding vineyards, the villa offers a setting where the landscape becomes part of every moment.

features.intro: At La Bogliona, everything feels closer.
features.paragraph1: Light enters through wide windows, opening the villa to the surrounding landscape, while inside, the atmosphere remains warm and grounded.
features.paragraph2: Evenings unfold slowly — by the fire, in the garden, or around the table — where time seems to soften and extend beyond the moment.

bottom.title:
Outside, a private garden and firepit
create a space for quiet evenings under the open sky.
bottom.description:
Surrounded by vineyards, the villa offers a rare sense
of stillness — where the world feels distant, and the moment becomes enough.

overview.title: I Bricchi is a villa defined by light and openness — where large windows and panoramic views bring the landscape into every room.
overview.description: Designed for shared moments and quiet reflection alike, it offers a contemporary space that feels both expansive and intimate.

features.intro: At I Bricchi, light becomes part of the experience.
features.paragraph1: Throughout the day, it moves through the villa, shifting the atmosphere from morning clarity to soft evening tones.
features.paragraph2: Spaces are designed for both gathering and retreat — from long conversations under the pergola to quiet moments by the fireplace.

bottom.title: Outside, a pergola-covered space creates a natural extension of the villa — a place for slow meals, conversation, and time spent outdoors at any hour of the day.
bottom.description: Surrounded by vineyards, the setting invites both movement and stillness.

overview.title: Tettimorra is a villa rooted in Piedmontese tradition — where the atmosphere of a historic countryside home has been carefully preserved and reimagined.
overview.description: With its restored wooden beams, quiet interiors, and direct views over the Monvigliero vineyard, it offers a stay defined by intimacy, authenticity, and a deep connection to the land.

features.intro: At Tettimorra, time moves differently — slower, more gently, following the rhythm of the vineyards.
features.paragraph1: From the terrace, the Monvigliero landscape unfolds like a continuous horizon of vines, changing with the light throughout the day.
features.paragraph2: Mornings begin in silence, with coffee overlooking the hills. Evenings settle into a quiet stillness, where the presence of the landscape becomes part of the experience.

bottom.title: A covered patio opens directly onto the Monvigliero vineyard, creating a rare continuity between the villa and the landscape.
bottom.description: Here, the view remains uninterrupted — a simple composition of earth, vine, and sky.
